title: Yummy Moroccan Fettuccine Pasta
description: A rich, aerated brunch-mood Moroccan fettuccine dish made with a silky sauce and a double-boiler technique, sugar-free friendly.
instructions: Bring a pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook 200g fettuccine until al dente, about 10 minutes.
While pasta cooks, heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion to the skillet and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes, then stir in 2 minced garlic cloves and cook for 30 seconds.
Stir in 1 tsp each of ground ginger, cumin, coriander, and smoked paprika, cooking until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Mix in 2 tbsp tomato paste, then pour in 2 cups vegetable stock, bringing the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce thicken for 5 minutes, then transfer it to a bain-marie over simmering water, holding for 5 minutes to keep it silky.
Drain the cooked pasta, reserving 1 cup of pasta water, then toss the pasta into the warm sauce, adding reserved pasta water as needed to achieve desired consistency.
Finish with 2 tbsp chopped cilantro and 1 tbsp lemon juice, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste, then serve immediately.
